seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,w,x,y x1, pixels,w,x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Two mirror axes (H band, V column) on a 3-cell grid plus holed 3x3-block pieces; ACTION5 cycles H->V->pieces; A1/A2 move H axis or selected piece in x, A3/A4 move V axis or selected piece in y; H selected with A3/A4 = no-op.
Reflections are derived from pieces: across V they are visible gray, across H or both they are invisible occluders. Layer order is piece > reflection > target > wall, then 4-connected components are re-extracted; targets merge when bbox gap <=3.
The reflection A3 hypothesis is not about click position. The mixed h/w/x/y outcomes come from re-rendering derived reflections and re-extracting components after the piece moves.
Naming: walls and pieces are ranked by bbox (x,y) including the other type 0-dots; reflections are ranked among visible and invisible components.
Unconfirmed: piece-piece/axis blocking, overlap order between visible and invisible reflections. Passes 44/44 both with hidden state and fully stateless.
